title: Bombay High Court raps CWC for "illegally" taking custody of child from adoptive parents
description: A local Child Welfare Committee (CWC) constituted under the Juvenile Justice Act (JJ Act) has no jurisdiction to seize an adopted child from her adoptive parents since the child is neither an ‘orphan’ nor ‘abandoned’ nor a ‘child in need of care and protection’ within the meaning of Section 2(14) of the JJ Act, the Bombay High Court recently ruled [ABC & Anr v. CWC & Ors.]. A division bench of Justices Urmila Joshi‑Phalke and Nivedita Mehta held that the CWC itself does not get any power
